_comment: Known engine bugs the fault suite trips, in the same format as scripts/integration/expected_failures.json. 'checks' maps fnmatch globs over check ids (<scenario>:<aspect>[@<pod>]) to a key in 'bugs'; each bug names its GitHub issue. Delete a bug and its globs when it is fixed. --strict also fails when a listed check passes.

bugs.#330: Concurrent first-boot migrations race: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS fails with a duplicate key on pg_namespace, so one of several pods booting against an unmigrated database exits
bugs.#368: S3 WAL self-fences after a connection reset on a WAL PUT (the SDK's retry of the conditional PUT gets 412): the ingest pod answers 500 to every write until it is restarted, so it does not recover from the S3 toxics before the restart
